title: Wire the Competency Compiler (capabilities/router.py, #165 on main) into the Goal Gravity loop as inert library code, with typed evidence, verified-outcome calibration and a builder-less acquisition chain; linked to DELIB-GOAL-GRAVITY-2026-10-13-001
problem: Observation: the 2026-10-13 directive (re-issued 2026-10-14) names the Competency Compiler as the intended engineering result. Observation: PR #165 merged capabilities/router.py to main on 2026-10-14; its own commit says nothing calls it and wiring waits on the entry gate. Observation: draft PR #160 already carries the Goal Gravity loop (persistent goals, GPS, classifier, Gate-only execution) with no epistemic routing: any trusted observation clears any gate, verification never calibrates mechanism choice, and a missing capability only blocks. Inference: the residual CapabilityDeficit is the seam between the two (gate -> problem class -> admissible methods -> recruited mechanism -> typed evidence -> verified outcome -> calibration) plus the acquisition path when the repertoire is insufficient. Proposal: build that seam inside egregore/ without editing the router's semantics, activating nothing.
baseline: main b2f2d21: capabilities/router.py (CapabilityRouter: route, compose exactly, record_outcome from independent verifiers, restore from the ledger, CapabilityDeficit) with no caller; draft PR #160 at ef369d1: Goal Gravity loop with untyped gates, verify_outcome that marks externally_verified but calibrates nothing, deficits that block but never resolve except by retention.

counterevidence.claim: The increment as first committed (81c90c7) met its own authority and evidence claims
counterevidence.finding: Refuted. An adversarial review raised 35 findings that reproduced on 81c90c7, including two blocking: a low-trust corroborator could relabel a trusted reading's method, and a re-dispatched attempt could be reconciled from an earlier attempt's Gate events. Others: attach without a founder answer, forged outcome events replayed into calibration, one goal's founder decision clearing another goal's gate. All are fixed with regression tests. The refuting verifiers and the completeness critic did not run (usage limit), so the findings were confirmed by re-running each reproduction, not by an independent verifier.

counterevidence.claim: capabilities/router.py is the Competency Compiler the loop should mount
counterevidence.finding: Contested by main. #170 labels the router a non-canonical alternative that must not be wired in as a second Competency Compiler and names the #143 seed-genome lineage as the canonical candidate. This branch keeps the mount optional and off by default; the choice of compiler is a founder decision.

pass_1.intended_outcome: GREG recognizes the kind of question each gate poses, recruits the smallest competent registered mechanism or composition inside the goal's envelope, accepts only evidence that kind of knowing can produce, learns mechanism reliability only from independent verification, and when nothing is competent opens a governed acquisition path that ends with the original goal resuming.

pass_2.attack_summary: Assume Pass 1 shipped. Attacks: (1) a proposer self-labels its observations with a strong method to clear gates; (2) a mechanism grades itself through a near-identical verifier name; (3) two loops diverge on calibration; (4) attach is triggered by a forged founder answer; (5) qualification runs arbitrary paths; (6) the institution's own derived signals wake goals in a loop.
